definition_zh: 通过轮轨相互作用联系起来的车辆与轨道系统。
usage_note: 保留 coupled；仅出现 vehicle–track system 时应检查上下文。vehicle 不自动替换为 train，车辆与列车应分别表达。
usage_overview: 用于将车辆、轨道及轮轨界面共同作为随机动力分析的整体对象，通过轮轨相互作用描述车辆与轨道之间的联系，并分析系统的随机动力响应。

complete_examples.text: The vehicle–track coupled system is a typical stochastic system, whose randomness can be characterised by system parameters and excitation sources.

To construct this model, the present paper has five main objectives: probability statistics, simulation, combination of the system stochastic factors, which include the system parameters and excitations; model of the vehicle–track coupled system and its verification; probability characteristics transmission between random factors and vibrating responses; and the modelling process of the vehicle–track temporal–spatial stochastic analysis system.
车辆-轨道耦合系统具有时-空域的随机特征。
该模型将车辆-轨道耦合系统分为车辆子系统、轨道子系统及轮轨界面系统,可考虑车辆系统、线路系统参数的随机性及轨道随机不平顺的时变性,同时采用数论法实现不同动力参数的组合,用概率密度演化方程解决系统激励输入与响应输出的概率密度传递问题。

Stochastic Model Used for Temporal-spatial Analysis of Vehicle-track Coupled Systems XU Lei, ZHAI Wanming (State Key Laboratory of Traction Power, Southwest Jiaotong University, Chengdu 610031, China) Abstracts: Vehicle-track coupled system has the random nature in time-space domain.
